uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Go 1.26 runtime support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Go 1.26 runtime is generally available for App Engine flexible environments; The Go 1.26 runtime entered preview for App Engine flexible environments.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment TLS 1.2+ with secure cipher suites
uncovered_features.feature_summary: TLS version 1.2 and later with the corresponding secure cipher suites is generally available for App Engine flexible environments; App Engine flexible environments offer TLS 1.2 and later with a corresponding secure set of cipher suites in Preview.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Go 1.25 runtime support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Go 1.25 runtime is generally available for App Engine flexible environments; The Go 1.25 runtime is available in preview for App Engine flexible environments.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment legacy TLS 1.1 and earlier support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Support for TLS versions 1.1 and earlier is deprecated in App Engine flexible environments; deprecated on March 2025.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Go 1.24 runtime support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Go 1.24 runtime is generally available for App Engine flexible environments; The Go 1.24 runtime entered preview for App Engine flexible environments.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Go 1.23 runtime support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Go 1.23 is generally available for App Engine flexible environments; Go 1.23 is available in preview for App Engine flexible environments.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine console runtime lifecycle stage filtering
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine console now lets users filter versions by runtime lifecycle stage and display warning icons for end-of-support or deprecated states.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Go 1.22 runtime support
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Go 1.22 runtime is generally available for App Engine flexible environments.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Legacy GOPATH mode (GO111MODULE=off) for Go on App Engine flexible
uncovered_features.feature_summary: For Go 1.22 and later on App Engine flexible environments, using `go get` outside a module in legacy GOPATH mode is no longer supported; deprecated on 2024-03-26.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Go 1.22 runtime support in App Engine flexible
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Adds preview support for the Go 1.22 runtime in App Engine flexible environment.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Go 1.21 runtime support in App Engine flexible
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Marks the Go 1.21 runtime as generally available in App Engine flexible environment; Introduces Go 1.21 runtime support in App Engine flexible environment in preview.

uncovered_features.feature_name: SSH access for internal-IP-only App Engine flexible instances
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Enables SSH login to App Engine flexible instances that use only internal IP addresses.
keywords: SSH to App Engine flexible VM

uncovered_features.feature_name: Go 1.18 and 1.19 runtime support in App Engine flexible
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Adds general availability for Go 1.18 and 1.19 runtimes in App Engine flexible; Introduces Go 1.18 and 1.19 runtime preview support built on Ubuntu 22 and Cloud buildpacks.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Internal IP mode for App Engine flexible instances
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Introduces the generally available option to set App Engine flexible instances to internal IP mode.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Disable external ephemeral IP addresses for App Engine Flex services
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Adds preview support for disabling external ephemeral IP addresses on App Engine Flex services.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional expansion
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine expanded to the us-west1 (Oregon), asia-southeast1 (Singapore), and asia-east1 (Taiwan) regions; App Engine became available in the europe-central2 (Warsaw) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine resource-level billing visibility
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine introduced per-resource billing labels for services with BigQuery export and query capabilities for detailed billing analysis.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region-based app URLs
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine changed app request URLs to include a region ID, with the new format optional for existing apps and standard for new apps.
keywords: App Engine region in requests URL

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Go regional expansion to asia-east2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment Go product became available in the asia-east2 (Hong Kong) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Default App Engine flexible environment Go runtime version 1.11
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The default Go runtime for App Engine flexible environment deployments was updated to Go 1.11.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Deprecation of new Go 1.6 and Go 1.8 App Engine deployments
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Deploying new applications using Go 1.6 or Go 1.8 on App Engine flexible environment is deprecated; deprecated on 2018-11-01.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Go 1.8 support deprecation on App Engine
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Support for Go 1.8 on App Engine flexible environment was deprecated; deprecated on 2018-08-01.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine flexible environment Go regional expansion to us-west2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment Go product became available in the us-west2 (Los Angeles) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Community feedback channel for App Engine Go
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine Go users can submit feedback through the google-appengine-go Google Group.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Default Go runtime behavior for `runtime: go` deployments
uncovered_features.feature_summary: For App Engine flexible environment deployments using `runtime: go`, the runtime now defaults to the latest Go release (1.10).

uncovered_features.feature_name: Go 1.10 runtime update
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The Go 1.10 runtime introduced faster builds and standard-library behavior changes, including updates to `bytes` and `net/url`.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine Go distroless base image
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine Go builds application images using `gcr.io/distroless/base` as the base image, producing smaller Debian-free container images.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Build pipeline generally available
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine flexible environment Go build pipeline reached general availability.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region expansion to northamerica-northeast1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the northamerica-northeast1 (Montréal) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine region expansion to asia-south1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the asia-south1 (Mumbai) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Default gzip response compression in App Engine flexible environment
uncovered_features.feature_summary: All responses in the App Engine flexible environment are compressed with gzip by default after redeploying the app.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine Go beta build pipeline updates
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine Go beta build pipeline was updated.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Distroless base image in App Engine Go beta builds
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The beta build pipeline now produces Go application images from `gcr.io/distroless/base`, reducing image size and removing bundled Go SDK/debian runtime utilities.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Per-second billing for App Engine flexible environment instances
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine flexible environment instance billing moved to per-second metering with a reduced minimum charge duration of one minute.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Legacy health checks
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Legacy health checks for App Engine were scheduled for removal; deprecated on 2018-09-30.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine custom domain mapping with gcloud and Admin API
uncovered_features.feature_summary: The App Engine custom domain mapping APIs and CLI commands (including `gcloud domains verify` and `apps.authorizedDomains.list`) reached general availability.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Managed SSL certificates for custom domains
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Managed certificates became available for custom domains, with App Engine automatically provisioning, renewing, and revoking certificates based on domain mapping state.

uncovered_features.feature_name: Managed SSL upgrade for existing custom domain mappings
uncovered_features.feature_summary: Existing domain mappings with SSL can be maintained and upgraded to use managed SSL certificates.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional expansion to southamerica-east1
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the southamerica-east1 (São Paulo, Brazil) region.
keywords: App Engine in São Paulo region

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional expansion to europe-west3
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the europe-west3 (Frankfurt, Germany) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional expansion to europe-west2
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the europe-west2 (London) region.

uncovered_features.feature_name: App Engine regional expansion to us-east4
uncovered_features.feature_summary: App Engine became available in the us-east4 (North Virginia) region.
